name: 20308-longprefill-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one engine on one GPU.
architecture: dense decoder (LlamaForCausalLM), 32 layers, 32 query heads / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, bf16; ~8.03e9 parameters, ~16 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, 300 requests, 1800 s safety cap, static seed 18152.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: prompt exactly 16000 tokens and output exactly 4 (min = max), greedy at temperature 0.0, `ignore_eos` so nothing stops early. `request_format: plain` in `scenario.json` must stay -- the backend's own default wraps the prompt in the checkpoint's chat template, which raises on every request of this engine era while the run still exits 0.
purpose: A document analysis assistant summarizing 16,000-token submissions one at a time with an 8B model on a single GPU.
launch:
# Launch config for 20308-longprefill-8b-1gpu: one GPU, one 8B dense model, 16000 tokens in and
# 4 tokens out, one request at a time. Every key below is passed straight to this engine's
# AsyncEngineArgs (`-` becomes `_`).

# `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` is gated; this is the ungated mirror of the same weights,
# cached locally (~16 GB).
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
dtype: bfloat16
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# PART OF THE DECLARATION, NOT A DEFAULT LEFT STANDING. The engine is built in-process, a usage
# context this commit's per-device default table does not cover, so leaving these out drops the
# engine to a class default of 2048 batched tokens. 16384 and 1024 are what this commit resolves
# to on a >=70 GiB non-A100 device.
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384
max-num-seqs: 1024

enable-chunked-prefill: true

# OFF, AND WRITTEN DOWN BECAUSE THE DEFAULT IS THE OTHER WAY. Prompts are drawn independently
# from the synthetic sampler, so a chance collision on their leading tokens would let the engine
# skip the work this item exists to time, and skipped work is a missing timing, not a fast one.
enable-prefix-caching: false

block-size: 16

# Smallest power of two clearing the longest request (16000 + 4); the checkpoint declares 131072.
max-model-len: 16384

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
